note: Issue #303: the dark master (src/systems/npc/dark_master_post.gd, src/systems/flow/dark_pact.gd). 'soldier': his soldier profile. 'cruiser': where he waits in the cruiser's bay ('at', cruiser frame) and the way he faces ('face'): just out of the corridor's door, facing it, so walking back from the bridge to your ship you pass him and his offer opens. 'roof': the town marker he stands on while the Remnant hold the planet ('offset' from it), facing 'face'. 'meet_reach': how close you walk before his offer opens by itself; 'turns': his lines before the game asks Join / Refuse outright ('turns_offline' with AI characters off, issue #328); 'end_delay': seconds after your answer ('join' / 'refuse') before the talk closes. 'standing': the Remnant standing you are raised to on 'join' and again to 'retaken' when the barracks guards are cleared (the Remnant who come back are your friends, whatever you shot on the way: a lower standing plus an armed, recently-firing player reads as hostile), and dropped to when you break the oath ('broken') or kill him while sworn ('killed'). 'friend_standing': at or above it (and the Remnant not hostile) you are their friend: in free play their ships are borrowed, not stolen (no alarm, no chase), each costing 'borrow_standing', and the desert droid posts sell at 'droid_discount' (the port's market does the same for friends of the locals); never under a droid's resale. 'blade': his sword fight (BladeFighter): 'reach' m, 'damage' a blow, 'cooldown_s' between blows, 'moves' (NativeMoves), 'deflect_chance' for a bolt from the front between blows, 'parry_chance' for a cut, 'blade_taken' (cuts that get through are multiplied by it), 'guard_cone_deg', 'stagger_s' when your block turns a blow, 'leap_min'/'leap_max'/'leap_cooldown_s'/'leap_s' for his bound (off the roof, or across the deck), 'climb' the height difference that means he must bound. His rhythm: a rush of 'flurry' [min, max] blows ('flurry_cd_s' apart; 'cooldown_s' after the last), then he steps back to 'spacing_m' [min, max] m (at most 'back_off_max_s' s), circles you for 'back_off_s' [min, max] s and comes again (running from beyond 'walk_in_m', walking in from closer; at once if you get 'lose_m' past his spacing); he still cuts at you if you step into reach meanwhile. 'clash': blade on blade (your block turns a blow, or his guard turns your cut): sparks 'height' m up between you, and both shoved apart at 'push' m/s fading by 'fade' m/s every second ('player_share' scales your shove). 'drops': the item he drops where he falls, a pickup ('blade_dropped' line); you activate it in the inventory. 'grip': the blade in his hand, in the rigged model's hand bone's space ('offset' m, 'rot' degrees; the blade runs up out of the fist). 'guard_pose': his arms while no blow plays (degrees): fist in front of the chest, blade up.

lines.brief: This is the moment you make your offer. The general is dead; you were waiting for whoever killed him. Tell the player there is a dark energy emerging, and say: 'Join me, and realize more power than you could know.' If they join, their first task is to clear the local guards from the barracks of {town}; the locals still think the player is on their side. When the player clearly says yes, use the join action; clearly no, use the refuse action. Do not end the talk any other way.
lines.brief_after: The player swore your oath. You stand watch over {town} for the Remnant.
lines.offer: There is a dark energy emerging. Join me, and realize more power than you could know.
lines.joined: Good. Your first task: clear the local guards from the barracks of {town}. They still think you are one of them. Let them think it.
lines.blade_dropped: The dark master's red blade falls from his hand.
